```{r}
chr2_35683372 <-read.csv("../chr2_35683372_small-2-validated/chr2_35683372.csv") 
chr2_35683372$Group_35683372 <- ifelse(chr2_35683372$Group_35683372 == 1, 1, 0)

chr2_920208286 <-read.csv("../chr2_920208286_small_validated/chr2_920208494.csv") 
chr2_920208286$Group_920208286 <- ifelse(chr2_920208286$Group_920208286 == 3, 1, 0)

chr2_1461736473 <-read.csv("../chr2_1461736473/small/chr2_1461736473.csv") 
chr2_1461736473$Group_1461736473 <- ifelse(chr2_1461736473$Group_1461736473 == 2, 1, 0)


pheno <-read.csv("../../../..//01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/01.dataset_filtering/02_A.pisum/final filters/acyrthosiphon_pisum_filtered_6.csv") 

merged_df_A <- merge(chr2_35683372, chr2_920208286, by = "ivip", all.x = TRUE) 
merged_df_B <- merge(merged_df_A, chr2_1461736473, by = "ivip", all.x = TRUE) 
merged_df_C <- merge(pheno, merged_df_B, by = "ivip", all.x = TRUE)

merged_df_C$Group_35683372 <- as.factor(merged_df_C$Group_35683372)
merged_df_C$Group_920208286 <- as.factor(merged_df_C$Group_920208286)
merged_df_C$Group_1461736473 <-as.factor(merged_df_C$Group_1461736473)



```

```{r}
#data prep P2xp006 
data_xp006<-read.csv("../../../../../01.data/P2-XP006_faba_vs_pisum_P123_fecundity-test/P2-XP006_larvae_fecundity_results.csv", stringsAsFactors = F)
data_xp006$block <- NA

data_xp006 <- data_xp006 %>% filter(!is.na(larvae_total_number))
data_filtered_xp006 <- data_xp006 %>% filter(adult_alive != "0")

#data prep P2xp008 
data_xp008<-read.csv("../../../../../01.data/P2-XP008_faba_apisum_confirmation_2/P2-XP008_fecundity_data_apisum.csv", stringsAsFactors = F)
data_xp008 <- data_xp008 %>% filter(!is.na(larvae_total_number))
data_filtered_xp008 <- data_xp008 %>% filter(adult_alive != "0")

#data prep P2xp010 ----
data_xp010<-read.csv("../../../../../01.data/P2-XP010_fabae_pisum_third_confirmation/P2XP010.csv", stringsAsFactors = F)
data_xp010 <- data_xp010 %>% filter(!is.na(larvae_total_number))
data_filtered_xp010 <- data_xp010 %>% filter(adult_alive != "0")


confirmation_merged <- bind_rows(
  data_filtered_xp006 %>%
    select(ivip, block, larvae_total_number) %>%
    mutate(session = "A"),
  data_filtered_xp008 %>%
    select(ivip, block, larvae_total_number) %>%
    mutate(session = "B"),
  
  data_filtered_xp010 %>%
    select(ivip, block, larvae_total_number) %>%
    mutate(session = "C")
)


merged_df_C$Group_920208286 <- as.factor(merged_df_C$Group_920208286)

confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype <- merge(confirmation_merged, merged_df_B, by = "ivip", all.x = FALSE)

confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$Group_35683372 <- as.factor(confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$Group_35683372)
confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$Group_920208286 <- as.factor(confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$Group_920208286)
confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$Group_1461736473<-as.factor(confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$Group_1461736473)


```

```{r}

merged_df_C <- merged_df_C %>%
  mutate(
    hap_group = case_when(
      Group_920208286 == 0 & Group_35683372 == 0 & Group_1461736473 == 0 ~ "None",
      Group_920208286 == 0 & Group_35683372 == 1 & Group_1461736473 == 0 ~ "H1",
      Group_920208286 == 1 & Group_35683372 == 0 & Group_1461736473 == 0 ~ "H2",
      Group_920208286 == 0 & Group_35683372 == 0 & Group_1461736473 == 1 ~ "H3",
      Group_920208286 == 1 & Group_35683372 == 1 & Group_1461736473 == 0 ~ "H1+H2",
      Group_920208286 == 0 & Group_35683372 == 1 & Group_1461736473 == 1 ~ "H1+H3",
      Group_920208286 == 1 & Group_35683372 == 0 & Group_1461736473 == 1 ~ "H2+H3",
      Group_920208286 == 1 & Group_35683372 == 1 & Group_1461736473 == 1 ~ "H1+H2+H3"
    )
  )
merged_df_C <- merged_df_C[!is.na(merged_df_C$hap_group), ]
summary(merged_df_C)

merged_df_C$hap_group<-as.factor(merged_df_C$hap_group)



```

```{r}
pheno <-read.csv("../../../..//01.GWAS/01_phenotipic_analysis/01.dataset_filtering/02_A.pisum/final filters/acyrthosiphon_pisum_filtered_6.csv") 

model_emmean <- lm(larvae_total_number ~ ivip, data = pheno)
class(emm)
# Estimated marginal means

emm <- emmeans(model_emmean, ~ ivip)

# Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons

cld <- multcomp::cld(emm, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey")

# View letters

cld

```

```{r}
ggplot(
  merged_df_C,
  aes(
    x = reorder(hap_group, larvae_total_number, FUN = median),
    y = larvae_total_number
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Favorable haplotype combination") +
  ylab("Phenotype")

```

```{r}

confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype <- confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype %>%
  mutate(
    hap_group = case_when(
      Group_920208286 == 0 & Group_35683372 == 0 & Group_1461736473 == 0 ~ "None",
      Group_920208286 == 0 & Group_35683372 == 1 & Group_1461736473 == 0 ~ "H1",
      Group_920208286 == 1 & Group_35683372 == 0 & Group_1461736473 == 0 ~ "H2",
      Group_920208286 == 0 & Group_35683372 == 0 & Group_1461736473 == 1 ~ "H3",
      Group_920208286 == 1 & Group_35683372 == 1 & Group_1461736473 == 0 ~ "H1+H2",
      Group_920208286 == 0 & Group_35683372 == 1 & Group_1461736473 == 1 ~ "H1+H3",
      Group_920208286 == 1 & Group_35683372 == 0 & Group_1461736473 == 1 ~ "H2+H3",
      Group_920208286 == 1 & Group_35683372 == 1 & Group_1461736473 == 1 ~ "H1+H2+H3"
    )
  )
confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype[!is.na(confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$hap_group), ]
confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$ivip<-as.factor(confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$ivip)
confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$hap_group<-as.factor(confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype$hap_group)
summary(confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype)
aggregate(ivip ~ hap_group,
          data = confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype,
          FUN = function(x) length(unique(x)))
data_filtered_xp008$ivip<-as.factor(data_filtered_xp008$ivip)
```

```{r}

model_haplotype_confirmation <- lm(larvae_total_number ~ hap_group/ivip  + session/block , data = confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype)

anova(model_haplotype_confirmation)

model_emmean <- lmer(larvae_total_number ~ hap_group + (1 | session), data = confirmation_merged_group_all_haplotype)


# Estimated marginal means

emm <- emmeans(model_emmean, ~ hap_group)

# Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons

cld <- multcomp::cld(emm, Letters = letters, adjust = "tukey")

# View letters

cld

```

  )
) +
